items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I saw him at the ASCAP ceremony. We got the Julliard was in 2002.

ctx.x: It’s in my book; I got 200 in there. Unique names, I call em.
Gonzala Rubolcabra, he was my favorite.
Yeah, Blueberry Cobbler. I called him that, he didn’t mind. I saw him at the ASCAP ceremony. We got the Julliard was in 2002.
